pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular polygonal regions with serrated, jagged perimeters. Edges show sharp pixel-level transitions between dark brown and light cream. Surface area of individual regions is greatest at the shoulder and diminishes significantly toward the lower flank and ventral transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream topological graph with non-uniform thickness. Intersection nodes are clearly visible as convergence points for three to five pathways. Pathways maintain continuity across the entire visible surface of the animal, narrowing at acute patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated profile of the mane along the dorsal neck. The 1D contour consists of dense, vertically oriented hair clusters producing a jagged silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, circular focal point is present on the upper-mid flank within a dark patch, suggesting a potential ectoparasite or localized lesion. A subtle linear textural disruption is visible on the lower-mid flank.
